drafted_from: tool:prepare-a-newsletter-audience and the signer used by createSite's unsubscribe route; its tag, duplicate, suppression and token tests
start_here: Read one page of subscribers from the pursuit's own database. Run tool:prepare-a-newsletter-audience with that page, its HTTPS origin, the vault name of the site's link key and any required or excluded tags. It sends nothing.
no_lists_because: It reads no store and creates no list. The newsletter workflow supplies the pursuit's existing subscriber rows and claims each send in that pursuit's own send table.
instructions: The site's createSite configuration owns signupTags and sourceTags. The form never supplies trusted tags. Pending subscribers wait for the confirmation link; only confirmed subscribers enter an issue's audience.

Pass subscribers with id, email, status and tags (an array or its JSON text), origin such as https://example.test, and key_name naming the site's held link secret. The value is mounted on descriptor 3 and never goes in the request.
required_tags matches all of its tags; excluded_tags excludes any of its tags. Empty selectors mean the whole confirmed page. Unknown states, pending rows and suppressions cannot enter the audience.

For each returned recipient, use unsubscribe_url in the message footer, List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post: List-Unsubscribe=One-Click. Claim the issue and subscriber in the pursuit's newsletter_sends table before tool:send-an-email. A repeated claim must send nothing.

The site's own unsubscribe route accepts the same signed link. A plain link and one-click POST end the subscription; replays do not change the first end time. A bad token cannot change a subscriber, and no unsubscribe can lower a concurrent suppression.
Page the store by subscriber id for larger lists. Keep recipients and signed links private. Record the provider message id and read its delivery event before calling an issue delivered.

worked_examples.title: Prepare one tagged confirmed recipient; exclude a suppression
worked_examples.ask: Select this page's guide subscribers and give them their site's unsubscribe links, without sending anything
worked_examples.hands_back: One audience row for reader-one, with its signed unsubscribe_url, count 1 and excluded 1. Nothing is sent; reader-two stays excluded.
